population: Retrospective development only; candidate list and windows known from earlier work

paired.method: Exploratory paired calendar-day block bootstrap; few demo days and cross-day dependence limit precision.

decision_experiment.scope: Exploratory demo period only, restricted to sampled synthetic candidate sets; not a test result or a commercial itinerary experiment.

limitations: Repeated development data, not independent confirmation
Observed BTS schedules are not booking-time snapshots
Calibration choice uses a short known October development window
Demo already seen; never a final test result
Candidate sets synthetic and sampled; same-carrier is not proof of ticket validity
